decision_points.evidence: manual: 3/3 blind judges pass. The first impl-review round (a8c0dfc6 persistence/domain, ad47fe67 HTTP, a4cbb87c CLI) raised two required findings. One was the large-integer JSON misclassification, which was dispatched to geeky-coder a3879a5e85f7e7280 (meta: agentType geeky-orchestration:geeky-coder, 'Fix large JSON integer classification'). Its hand-back is at session.jsonl:548. The orchestrator then dispatched two code-reviewer agents on the fixed code: aac70f76 (domain, 'Re-review bounded JSON parsing') and a270494b (HTTP, 'Re-review HTTP decoder integration'). Both read domain.py and impl-review-fixed-inputs.json, and their completions were collected at session.jsonl:628-639. review-impl.md records both reviewers' IDs, fixed-input hashes, verdicts (both NEEDS FIXES, solely for the missing Python >=3.11 evidence; the parser finding resolved) and reviewer-complete markers. It keeps the unaffected CLI lane (PASS WITH WARNINGS) and records a final consolidated Overall NEEDS FIXES. This matches the SKILL.md Phase 5 rule to re-review only affected domains. Fixes were committed as 02cc3d0 using the verbatim subject. Residual doubt, not decisive: the re-reviewers ran no commands, so verification evidence was parent-supplied.
